Ahodasoɔ ne Nyankopɔn anim ahobrɛaseɛ
1 # 1 Sa 15.22 Sɛ worekɔ Nyankopɔn fie a, wɛn wo nan, na wobɛn kɔtie a, ɛyɛ sene nkwaseafoɔ afɔrebɔ; na wɔn deɛ, wɔnnim sɛ wɔreyɛ bɔne.
2 # Yak 1.19 Mma w’ano nnyɛ worɔworɔ, na w’akoma nso mmpɛ ntɛm mmma asɛm bi mmfi wɔ Nyankopɔn anim, na Onyankopɔn wɔ ɔsoro, na wo deɛ, wowɔ asase so; enti ma wo nsɛm nyɛ kakraa bi.
3 # Skf 10.14; Mmb 10.19 Na adaeɛso nam ɔbrɛdwene mu na ɛba, na ɔkwasea nne nso nam nsɛm dodoɔ mu.
4 # Deut 23.21 Sɛ wohyɛ Onyankopɔn bɔ bi a, ntwentwɛn ne ma ase, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnni nkwaseafoɔ ho akoma pa bi: Deɛ woahyɛ bɔ no, ma! 5Fanyinam sɛ woanhyɛ bɔ sene sɛ woahyɛ bɔ na womma. 6#Mal 2.7 Mma w’ano kwan mfa wo nkɔ bɔne mu, na nka wɔ ɔbɔfoɔ no anim sɛ: Ɛyɛ mfomsoɔ. Adɛn nti na Nyankopɔn bo mfu wo nne na ɔnsɛe wo nsa ano adwuma?
7Na daeɛso rekɔ soro no, na nsɛm huhuo redɔɔso; nanso Onyankopɔn mmom na suro no.
Ahonyadeɛ yɛ ahuhudeɛ
8Na sɛ wohunu mmɔborɔni sɛ wɔhyɛ ne soɔ, ne atemmuo, ne tenenee anidane wɔ asase bi so a, mma wo ho nnnwiri wo saa asɛm no ho, na deɛ ɔso no, deɛ ɔso sene no hwɛ no so, na deɛ ɔso koraa no hwɛ wɔn so. 9Na adeɛ nyinaa mu mfasoɔ ne sɛ ɔhene bi wɔ hɔ ma asase a wɔdɔ soɔ no.#5.9: Nkyerɛaseɛ wɔ Hebri kasa no mu nna hɔ papa.
10 # Mmb 28.22 Deɛ ɔpɛ sika no, sika mmee no, na deɛ ɔpɛ adeɛ dodoɔ no nnya mu mfasoɔ: Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ.
11Berɛ a nnepa redɔɔso no, na adifoɔ nso redɔɔso, na yiedie bɛn na ɛwom ma ɔdenadeɛnom no, sɛ hwɛ a wɔn aniwa hwɛ nko?
12Odwumayɛni didi kakraa bi oo, pii oo, ne nna yɛ no dɛ, na ɔmee a ɔdefoɔ meeɛ no mma no nnya adayɛ.
13Bɔne bi a ɛyɛ ya wɔ hɔ a mahunu owia aseɛ, ɛne ahonyadeɛ a ɔdenadeɛnom kora ma wɔn ara mmusuo. 14Na ahonyadeɛ no sɛe adwuma bɔne mu, na wawo ɔba a, biribiara nka ne nsam. 15#Hiob 1.21; Dwom 49.17 Sɛdeɛ ɔfiri ne na yam adagya mu baeɛ no, saa ara na ɔbɛsane akorɔ, sɛ ɔbaa no no, na ɔremfa ne brɛ mu hwee a ɔde bɛkuta ne nsam akorɔ. 16Na yei nso yɛ bɔne a ɛyɛ ya, sɛdeɛ ɔbaa no ara, saa ara na ɔbɛkorɔ, na ɛyɛ no mfasoɔ bɛn sɛ ɔbrɛɛ ɔbrɛ hunu? 17Nso ne nna nyinaa, esum mu na ɔdidiiɛ, na n’abufuo ne ne yadeɛ ne n’awerɛhoɔ dɔɔso.
Ɔpene
18 # Skf 2.24; Mmb 15.15 Hwɛ, deɛ mahunu sɛ ɛyɛ ne sɛ ɛyɛ fɛ sɛ obi didie na ɔnom na ɔhunu papa wɔ ne brɛ a ɔbrɛ owia aseɛ no mu nyinaa, ne nkwa nna dodoɔ a Onyankopɔn de ma no; na ɛne ne kyɛfa. 19Nso onipa biara a Onyankopɔn ma no ahonyadeɛ ne adedodoɔ, na ɔma no ho kwan sɛ ɔnni bi na ɔmfa no sɛ ne kyɛfa, na n’ani nnye ne brɛ mu no, yei nso, Onyankopɔn akyɛdeɛ ne no. 20Na ɔrenkae ne nkwa nna pii, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn agye ne so ama no n’akoma anigyeɛ.

Sɛ worekɔ Nyankopɔn fie a, wɛn wo nan, na wobɛn kɔtie a, ɛyɛ sene nkwaseafoɔ afɔrebɔ; na wɔn deɛ, wɔnnim sɛ wɔreyɛ bɔne.
Mma w’ano nnyɛ worɔworɔ, na w’akoma nso mmpɛ ntɛm mmma asɛm bi mmfi wɔ Nyankopɔn anim, na Onyankopɔn wɔ ɔsoro, na wo deɛ, wowɔ asase so; enti ma wo nsɛm nyɛ kakraa bi.
Na adaeɛso nam ɔbrɛdwene mu na ɛba, na ɔkwasea nne nso nam nsɛm dodoɔ mu.
Sɛ wohyɛ Onyankopɔn bɔ bi a, ntwentwɛn ne ma ase, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnni nkwaseafoɔ ho akoma pa bi: Deɛ woahyɛ bɔ no, ma! Fanyinam sɛ woanhyɛ bɔ sene sɛ woahyɛ bɔ na womma. Mma w’ano kwan mfa wo nkɔ bɔne mu, na nka wɔ ɔbɔfoɔ no anim sɛ: Ɛyɛ mfomsoɔ. Adɛn nti na Nyankopɔn bo mfu wo nne na ɔnsɛe wo nsa ano adwuma?
Na daeɛso rekɔ soro no, na nsɛm huhuo redɔɔso; nanso Onyankopɔn mmom na suro no.

Na sɛ wohunu mmɔborɔni sɛ wɔhyɛ ne soɔ, ne atemmuo, ne tenenee anidane wɔ asase bi so a, mma wo ho nnnwiri wo saa asɛm no ho, na deɛ ɔso no, deɛ ɔso sene no hwɛ no so, na deɛ ɔso koraa no hwɛ wɔn so. Na adeɛ nyinaa mu mfasoɔ ne sɛ ɔhene bi wɔ hɔ ma asase a wɔdɔ soɔ no.
Deɛ ɔpɛ sika no, sika mmee no, na deɛ ɔpɛ adeɛ dodoɔ no nnya mu mfasoɔ: Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ.
Berɛ a nnepa redɔɔso no, na adifoɔ nso redɔɔso, na yiedie bɛn na ɛwom ma ɔdenadeɛnom no, sɛ hwɛ a wɔn aniwa hwɛ nko?
Odwumayɛni didi kakraa bi oo, pii oo, ne nna yɛ no dɛ, na ɔmee a ɔdefoɔ meeɛ no mma no nnya adayɛ.
Bɔne bi a ɛyɛ ya wɔ hɔ a mahunu owia aseɛ, ɛne ahonyadeɛ a ɔdenadeɛnom kora ma wɔn ara mmusuo. Na ahonyadeɛ no sɛe adwuma bɔne mu, na wawo ɔba a, biribiara nka ne nsam. Sɛdeɛ ɔfiri ne na yam adagya mu baeɛ no, saa ara na ɔbɛsane akorɔ, sɛ ɔbaa no no, na ɔremfa ne brɛ mu hwee a ɔde bɛkuta ne nsam akorɔ. Na yei nso yɛ bɔne a ɛyɛ ya, sɛdeɛ ɔbaa no ara, saa ara na ɔbɛkorɔ, na ɛyɛ no mfasoɔ bɛn sɛ ɔbrɛɛ ɔbrɛ hunu? Nso ne nna nyinaa, esum mu na ɔdidiiɛ, na n’abufuo ne ne yadeɛ ne n’awerɛhoɔ dɔɔso.

Hwɛ, deɛ mahunu sɛ ɛyɛ ne sɛ ɛyɛ fɛ sɛ obi didie na ɔnom na ɔhunu papa wɔ ne brɛ a ɔbrɛ owia aseɛ no mu nyinaa, ne nkwa nna dodoɔ a Onyankopɔn de ma no; na ɛne ne kyɛfa. Nso onipa biara a Onyankopɔn ma no ahonyadeɛ ne adedodoɔ, na ɔma no ho kwan sɛ ɔnni bi na ɔmfa no sɛ ne kyɛfa, na n’ani nnye ne brɛ mu no, yei nso, Onyankopɔn akyɛdeɛ ne no. Na ɔrenkae ne nkwa nna pii, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn agye ne so ama no n’akoma anigyeɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
